title: An editor with samples of the author’s voice
description: Suggestions are checked against the samples chosen, and the changes stay under control.

blocks.text: All-purpose improvement often removes the characteristic short sentences and the personal intonation. The author needs help inside their own manner.

quote.text: I wish there was an option to make AI portions tone match and skill match what has already been written, its been several times its completely changed the skill level I write at making it feel disingenuous

blocks.text: Let people choose their own samples and describe their preferences. Show which changes have to do with grammar and which with tone.
One author’s different jobs can sound different. A profile for business email should not be applied automatically to a personal story.
